clue.text: American member knocked by anger about arena

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament
to knock something is to hit it
heat is anger or passion, as in the heat of the moment
re means about or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: An American politician gets struck by a furious crowd around a sports ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 'about' is not a containment signal; it simply gives RE, the Latin-derived word for 'concerning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an open-air oval venue with tiered seats around a central space is an arena.

clue.text: Prosecutor constant in account on employer

indicators.note: the constant's letter sits in the middle of the account's abbreviation

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant (and the speed of light) in physics
a user is one who employs or makes use of something

explanation.surface: A prosecuting lawyer is steadily reliant on a bookkeeping record about their boss.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the second piece below the first, so USER follows ACC.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the person who brings a charge against someone, as a prosecutor does in court.

clue.text: Well-liked university in London area

indicators.note: the university's letter is placed inside the district's name

parts.note: Poplar is a district in East London

explanation.surface: A college in the capital is fondly regarded.
explanation.walkthrough: POPLAR is a district in the East End of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something widely liked and admired is popular.

clue.text: Weighty foreign product containing bronze

indicators.note: the product word holds the colour word inside it

parts.note: an import is goods brought in from abroad
a tan is the bronzed colour skin goes in the sun

explanation.surface: A heavy item from abroad has bronze inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a weighty matter is serious and significant.

clue.text: Private detective left out what pigeon does?

indicators.note: out signals that the letter for left is dropped from the detective's name

parts.note: Sherlock Holmes is the most famous fictional detective

explanation.surface: A sleuth has gone, leaving a question about a bird's habits.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the definition by example: a homing pigeon finds its way back.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a homing pigeon flies straight back to its loft, so it is said to home.

clue.text: Drunk sat in a skip has to leave booze alone

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go inside the a-plus-container pair

parts.note: a skip is a large waste container, a bin

indicators.note: drunk means mixed up or reeling, so the letters of sat are rearranged

explanation.surface: A drunk sitting in a rubbish skip needs to give up drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: A skip is a British open-topped rubbish container used for building waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage: to abstain is to refrain from something, especially from drinking alcohol.

clue.text: Collide with neutrino, energy given up in decay

indicators.note: given up says the energy letter is surrendered from the particle's letters
decay suggests breaking down, so the remaining letters are reshuffled

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A particle physics scene: something collides with a neutrino as energy is released in radioactive decay.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the E out of NEUTRINO, leaving NUTRINO, and 'in decay' rearranges those seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: to run into something is to crash or bump against it.

clue.text: One joining ministers before God

parts.note: the Cabinet is the body of senior government ministers
the Maker is a name for God as creator

explanation.surface: Someone uniting the government's ministers ahead of divine authority.
explanation.walkthrough: A joiner is a woodworker, so 'One joining' is a carpenter; 'before' places the ministers first.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: a joiner is a carpenter, and a craftsman who builds furniture is a joiner of wood.

clue.text: Drink makes Coppola drunk

indicators.note: drunk means reeling and disordered, so the director's name is scrambled

explanation.surface: A beverage gets the film director Coppola intoxicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sweet bottled beverage flavoured like a soft drink but containing alcohol.

clue.text: Thoughts Greek character belts out

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet
to belt out a song is to sing it loudly

explanation.surface: A Greek person loudly voices what they are thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' suggests a person, but it is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: reflective ponderings or reveries are thoughts.

clue.text: Others trying to change physics concept

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Other people attempting to overturn an idea in physics.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a theoretical framework in which particles are modelled as tiny vibrating strands.

clue.text: Urinals to be refurbished or withdrawn

indicators.note: refurbishing remodels something, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: The public toilets are to be renovated or else taken out of service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'withdrawn' looks like a renovation alternative; it is the definition, meaning aloof.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an inward-looking, detached person is withdrawn from the wider world.

clue.text: Wrench being small one removed from bag

indicators.note: the letter for one is taken out of the bag word

parts.note: a pannier is a bag slung on a bicycle or pack animal
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A small tool taken out of a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wrench' could be a verb, but it is the tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in British English the tool for turning nuts is called a spanner; Americans call it a wrench.

clue.text: Deposing leader in panic is mistake

indicators.note: deposing the leader removes the first letter of the word for panic

parts.note: terror is extreme fear or panic

explanation.surface: Overthrowing a ruler in a moment of panic turns out to be an error of judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a blunder or slip is a mistake.

clue.text: Planner wild about house that's blown up

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the house abbreviation
wild means unruly, so the letters of planner are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wild planner is raging about a house that has been demolished by explosion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blown up' suggests an explosion, but the instrument is blown, often up in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic hint: a very long wooden horn of the Alps is played by blowing into it.

clue.text: Obsession that keeps one going to matches?

definitions.text: Obsession that keeps one going to matches?

parts.words: Obsession that keeps one going to matches?
parts.note: reads like a sports fan's devotion, but matches are things struck to light fires, so this compulsion is an urge to start fires

explanation.surface: A fan's obsession that takes them to every game.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: a compulsive urge to set fires has the sufferer reaching for matches.

clue.text: Teenager once right about muse and minister

indicators.note: the right letter comes round after the muse

parts.note: Mods were a 1960s British youth subculture
Erato is the Muse of lyric and love poetry

explanation.surface: A 1960s youth, a muse and a clergyman form an odd trio.
explanation.walkthrough: MODs were scooter-riding 1960s British youths. A Moderator chairs a Presbyterian church assembly.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage: in Presbyterian churches the minister who presides over an assembly holds this title.

clue.text: Set out at night? Wind reduced in valley

indicators.note: the shortened winding word goes inside the valley word

parts.note: a dene is a narrow wooded valley

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the final letter goes

parts.note: to wind is to turn, as in winding a key

explanation.surface: A cryptic picture of something laid out at night while the wind drops in a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set' is a set of teeth, put out in a glass at night; 'Wind' is the verb, not the breeze.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: false teeth form a set that many wearers take out before bed.

clue.text: Notice one in tirade incandescent

indicators.note: the notice and the numeral sit inside the tirade word

parts.note: a rant is an angry tirade
an ad is a notice or advertisement
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Seeing a single person mid-rant who is incandescent with rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incandescent' suggests fury, matching the tirade, but here it means glowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something incandescent glows with light, as a radiant source does.

clue.text: Adult Glaswegian perhaps in racing venue

parts.note: A is the film-certificate abbreviation for adult
a Glaswegian is an example of a Scot

explanation.surface: A grown-up from Glasgow at a horse-racing meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascot is a famous English racecourse near Windsor.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a celebrated racecourse in Berkshire, home of the Royal meeting.

clue.text: Performer one at rest moved around

indicators.note: moving the letters around rearranges them

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A performer, while resting, gets shifted about the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a professional entertainer, especially a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Vehicle in disturbance after tea

indicators.note: the disturbance word comes after the tea word

parts.note: cha (or char) is British slang for tea
a riot is a violent disturbance

explanation.surface: A van caught up in unrest after afternoon tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a two-wheeled horse-drawn ancient carriage used in racing and war.

clue.text: Family mass involves strange god in sovereign state

indicators.note: the family-plus-mass pair wraps around the scrambled letters

parts.note: kin are one's relatives or family
M is the physics symbol for mass

indicators.note: strange signals the letters of god are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: A family Mass involves a peculiar deity in a sovereign country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mass' suggests church, but it gives M, the physics symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a realm ruled by a monarch is a sovereign territory.

clue.text: Convenes where pork, beef and lamb discussed?

indicators.note: discussed means spoken about, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: these are all kinds of meat

explanation.surface: A butcher's committee gathers to talk about the cuts on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a group that assembles or gathers is said to convene.

clue.text: Neo with feudal lord in flammable gas

parts.note: Neo is the setter, so the setter refers to themselves as me
a thane held land from a king in Anglo-Saxon and Scottish feudal society

explanation.surface: The setter teams up with a medieval lord inside a gas cloud.
explanation.walkthrough: Neo is this puzzle's setter, so his name gives ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the main component of natural gas, which burns readily.

clue.text: Food is youngster debauched man eats

indicators.note: eating takes the youngster word inside the debauched man

parts.note: a roué is a dissolute, debauched man
a lad is a young boy

explanation.surface: A sinister scene: a debauched man devours a youngster as his meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rolled dish, sponge or meat filled and rolled up.

clue.text: Close to policeman because row even worse

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter

parts.note: as means because, as in 'as it was raining'
a tier is a row, as of seats

explanation.surface: Getting close to a police officer because an argument is turning even uglier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' reads as a quarrel; it is a row of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative: more unpleasant or more spiteful than something already bad.

clue.text: Old books in will that's changed?

definitions.text: Old books in will that's changed?

parts.words: Old books in will that's changed?
parts.note: a revised testament is a fresh will, yet this is the ancient later section of the Bible

explanation.surface: Antique volumes bequeathed in a will that has been altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: the Christian scriptures' second part is ancient books, and a changed will is a fresh testament.
